parsed.notes: Actual ratios not disclosed; company states it was in compliance with all covenants as of September 30, 2026, with the revolver undrawn. Net leverage limit steps up by 0.50x (max 5.00x) for three quarters after a material acquisition. The 3.50x secured net leverage test is a pro forma condition for the expansion feature, not a maintenance covenant, and is excluded; leverage-based pricing grids are also excluded.
